question: Is the phase-one local archive boundary—fresh same-connection status plus explicit no-other-runner confirmation—acceptable despite Codex status being process-local?
rationale: Code and upstream contracts establish the implemented safeguards, but only maintainers can accept the remaining cross-process ownership risk for destructive native-thread archive.

options.title: Accept bounded local archive
options.body: Land archive with the current confirmation and connection-bound checks while active and remote sources remain read-only.

options.title: Defer source archive
options.body: Ship discovery and safe branch continuation but remove archive until Codex exposes cross-process ownership fencing.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded local archive
recommendation.body: Land archive with the current confirmation and connection-bound checks while active and remote sources remain read-only.
